summary: Fixed-capacity 31-character NUL-terminated string from the std template library: a class/vtable word at +0 followed by a 32-byte inline char buffer (+4..+35); used for effect-part, model and attachment-point names.
evidence: ctor 0x006F4528 stores vptr 0x00782750, clamps strlen(src)+1 to 0x1F, memcpy to out+4, writes NUL at out+4+len, then overwrites the vptr with 0x00782534 (slot 0 = no-op 0x00572C48); copy ctor 0x00572C20 installs the same pair around a 32-byte buffer copy. Model_Attach_InitPointNames (0x0068C710) places three consecutive instances at 0x007C50B4, 0x007C50D8, 0x007C50FC, establishing stride 0x24 = 36 bytes. The 32-byte inline char buffer (+4..+35) is documented here per batch contract (only batch offsets emitted).

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: every ctor writes a per-instantiation rodata pointer here (0x00782750 during construction, then 0x00782534 whose first slot is the no-op bx-lr function 0x00572C48); copy ctor 0x00572C20 sets the same pair while copying the buffer at +4

summary: Shared header of the std template wide-string family (FixedWString<N>): a class/vtable word at +0 followed at +4 by an inline wchar_t buffer whose length is the capacity baked into each instantiation (2..256); the FormatCtor/FormatInit formatters vswprintf into +4.
evidence: FormatCtorA-I (0x006F0CE4..0x006F0F24) and FormatInitA-E (0x00707C24..0x00707CB4) each install their own rodata class word (0x007820A0..0x00782130), clear the wchar_t at +4 and format into out+4; callers pass result+4 (e.g. Ui_TextLayer_SetText in Ui_ItemRows_RefreshRows). Size 4 is only the shared header; the buffer follows per instantiation.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: every wide-string ctor writes a distinct rodata pointer here (0x007820A0 for capacity 10, 0x007820F0 for 3, 0x00782130 for 8, ...) before clearing and formatting +4; the word is never updated to point at out+4, so it is the class/vtable identity, not the string data pointer
